description: Builds a customer case study from the customer name, your product and the challenge, solution and results you give (mode full), or an interview kit for collecting them (mode discovery). Optional customer industry, quote, interview notes and business model fit the wording to the customer. Returns a headline, the story with each result you list, a customer quote, social and email copy and sector notes when the sector can be read from your text. A bracket marks anything you did not give.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge, so the advice fits it. If omitted, it is read from your text and the answer says how.

challenge.description: The customer's challenge or problem (needed in full mode)

customer_industry.description: The customer's industry, used for context

customer_quote.description: Optional: a direct quote from the customer

interview_notes.description: Optional: raw interview notes or a transcript. In full mode they fill a missing challenge, solution or results; the answer says they were not used when you gave all three

mode.description: full builds the case study and needs the challenge, solution and results; discovery returns interview questions for collecting them

results.description: Measurable outcomes, one per line or per semicolon (needed in full mode)

solution.description: How your product solved it (needed in full mode)

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.

name: case_study_generator
title: Case Study Generator
